## What To Look For

Both panels upload the same uniformly colored 5x5x5 sphere lattice, but only the right panel applies a depth-cue descriptor to the visual. The uniform material makes the progressive fade toward the background attributable to depth rather than a color mapping. In live mode, use the GUI to change cue mode, depth metric, falloff, near/far depth, strength, density, and background color while the linked arcball keeps both views aligned.
